note: What a server sends to say a unit is swinging at another, carrying where the swinging unit stands as well as what it swings at. The header names the unit acting.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit swung at. A client throws the swing at it.

fields.name: timing
fields.note: A shift in time: the value less 128, in hundredths of a second, from -1.28 to 1.27; 128 shifts nothing. It moves when the swing lets go and ends, and when the unit may next attack.

fields.name: missile
fields.note: The name the missile this swing throws will answer to. Zero for a swing that throws none.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the unit's attacks this is.

fields.name: fromX
fields.note: Where the swinging unit stands, along one ground axis, in world units. Where the unit stands more than 400 units from this point, a client first moves it there; nearer, the point has no effect.

fields.name: fromZ
fields.note: Where it stands, along the other, in world units.
